ShortDescription.Value: Updated, working build of Extended Road Upgrades for game 1.5+. Not compatible with the original mod: disable it first.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Important - read before subscribing
This is **not the original mod**. It is an independent continuation of *Extended Road Upgrades* by ST-Apps, which was last updated for game version 1.4 and no longer loads with game versions 1.5 / 1.6.
**This mod cannot be used together with the original Extended Road Upgrades.** Both register the same upgrade modes and patch the same game methods, so having both enabled duplicates the upgrade modes and produces conflicting road data. Disable or unsubscribe from the original mod and restart the game before using this one.
## Description This mod enables some additional upgrade modes for your roads, giving you full control on the type of roads you can build without needing to precisely terraform beforehand.
These upgrades are available in the in-game upgrade mode for roads and can be used exactly like any other upgrade mode (e.g. Grass or Wide Sidewalk).
The mod currently supports the following modes: - Quay - Retaining Wall - Elevated - Tunnel
These upgrades can be applied to: - Roads - Pedestrian Paths - Public Transport Roads - Train Tracks - Tram Tracks - Subway Tracks
## Compatibility - Supported game versions: 1.5 and newer (developed and tested against 1.6.2). - Not compatible with the original Extended Road Upgrades mod - the two cannot be enabled at the same time. - Existing saves keep working. Roads upgraded with the original mod remain valid; just re-apply the upgrade if a road looks wrong.
## Credits and license - Original mod and most of this code: **Extended Road Upgrades** by ST-Apps (https://github.com/ST-Apps/CS2-ExtendedRoadUpgrades), licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. - This is a modified version of that work: ported to game version 1.6, renamed and published as a separate entry. The list of changes is in the changelog below. - Because the original is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike), this continuation is distributed under the same license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). It must stay free of charge, keep the attribution above, and any further redistribution or modification must use the same license. - This continuation is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by the original author. - The mod bundles Harmony (0Harmony.dll) by Andreas Pardeike, redistributed under the MIT license; the full notice is in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt inside the mod folder.
Publish.ChangeLog:
# 1.0.0
First release of the independent continuation of Extended Road Upgrades, ported to game version 1.6. Versioning restarts at 1.0.0 because this is published as a separate mod entry.
- [NEW] This is a separate mod from the original Extended Road Upgrades: the two cannot be enabled at the same time (disable the original first) - [FIX] Mod not loading anymore with game versions 1.5 / 1.6 (the old build called game methods that no longer exist) - [FIX] Upgrade prefabs are now copied with the game's own clone routine: no more "referenced from another prefab" errors and no more corruption of the vanilla upgrade - [FIX] Upgrades are installed even if the game prefabs are not ready yet at load time - [ADD] A clear error is logged when another version of the mod already registered the upgrade prefabs
